name: Sint Eustatius
summary: The “Golden Rock”: a trading island repeatedly seized by rival powers.
notes: British attacks in 1781 targeted a vital entrepôt supplying Britain’s enemies. Privateer raids lasting days in 1709 and 1713 are annotations; the 1673 Dutch recapture is retained because it interrupted an established military administration.

events.title: A Spanish claim
events.detail: The island was associated with Columbus’s second voyage; no lasting Spanish colony followed.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: A Dutch colony
events.detail: Dutch settlers established a colonial trading post.

events.title: English occupation
events.detail: The Second Anglo-Dutch War brought English forces.

events.title: French forces take the island
events.detail: France acted as a Dutch ally against England.

events.title: Dutch possession restored
events.detail: The peace returned the colony to Dutch administration.

events.title: England takes the colony again
events.detail: The Third Anglo-Dutch War reached the island.

events.title: A short Dutch recapture
events.detail: Dutch forces briefly retook the island.

events.title: English forces return
events.detail: The Dutch recapture lasted days.

events.title: Dutch government restored
events.detail: The long English occupation ended.
events.uncertainty: Some summaries substitute the 1674 peace date; this is the administration chronology’s handover date.

events.title: French occupation
events.detail: The Nine Years’ War brought a French seizure.

events.title: English forces displace France
events.detail: English troops took the colony from the French.

events.title: The Dutch return
events.detail: English military administration ended.

events.title: French privateers raid the island
events.detail: A short ransom raid was not a durable sovereign transfer.

events.title: Cassard’s privateers return
events.detail: French raiders again held the island briefly for ransom.

events.title: Rodney seizes the Golden Rock
events.detail: Britain captured and plundered the commercial entrepôt in the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War.

events.title: French forces retake the island
events.detail: A French expedition displaced the British.

events.title: Dutch administration restored
events.detail: The peace settlement restored the colony.

events.title: French military occupation
events.detail: French forces established control during the revolutionary wars.

events.title: British occupation
events.detail: British troops displaced French military control.

events.title: Dutch government returns
events.detail: The Treaty of Amiens was implemented.

events.title: A final British occupation
events.detail: The Napoleonic Wars brought another seizure.

events.title: The Netherlands regains the island
events.detail: Postwar restitution was implemented.

events.title: A public body of the Netherlands
events.detail: The Netherlands Antilles dissolved; Statia joined the Caribbean Netherlands.
